title: Mileage Overage Deductions on Trade-In Agreements
content:
A mileage deduction applies on a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement when the odometer found at the pickup inspection is above the mileage the customer stated for the offer.

## Rule

A mileage deduction is booked on a picked-up trade-in agreement as one value deduction entry for mileage overage, dated the day it is booked, and it lowers the undistributed trade equity by its amount. The waiting period after pickup that holds back a title-delay chargeback does not hold back a mileage deduction, which is posted on a picked-up agreement whenever the inspection supports it.

## Business effect

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Agreement history | One value deduction entry with the reason mileage overage, dated the booking day |
| Undistributed trade equity | Lower by the amount of the deduction |
| Agreement status | Picked up, before and after |

## Care console reference: `post_mileage_deduction_140e91ac`

**Capability.** Books, on one customer's trade-in agreement, the deduction taken because the odometer found at the pickup inspection is higher than the mileage the customer stated for the offer. One call books one mileage deduction entry dated today for the amount given and lowers the agreement's undistributed trade equity by that same amount; the entry shows in the agreement's history with the reason `mileage_overage`, and the lower equity is what the customer sees on the agreement.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `post_mileage_deduction_140e91ac`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_in_id` | Reference number of the customer's trade-in agreement, as shown by the trade-in agreement lookup for this customer | Id |
| `deduction_amount` | The mileage deduction to book | USD, a positive amount to 2 decimal places (rounded to the nearest cent); 0.00 is not a meaningful entry |

**Return.** A text rendering of a receipt with `entry_id` (reference number of the new deduction entry), `trade_in_id` (the agreement it was booked on), `adjustment_type` (always `mileage_overage`), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the deduction booked), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date it posted) and `equity_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the agreement's undistributed trade equity with the deduction booked). A receipt carrying an `entry_id` means the deduction is booked.

## Illustration (hypothetical receipt)

Booking a deduction of 84.37 on an agreement whose undistributed trade equity stood at 9100.00 returns a receipt showing `adjustment_type` `mileage_overage`, `amount` 84.37 and `equity_balance` 9015.63.
